campaigns.titleMm: လွှဲပြောင်းချိန်ကို ယုံကြည်စေမယ့် Handover Hour
campaigns.format: B2B handover-proof pop-up and appointment clinic
campaigns.commercialTension: Customers can be told an item is moving, but cannot see who owns the next handover or what information will travel with it.
campaigns.audience: Operations, procurement and customer-service leaders who need a clearer service handover conversation.
campaigns.objective: Move from generic logistics interest to a client-approved service-discovery appointment.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A three-step handover card maps a hypothetical order journey and prompts a consented service-discovery booking; no live tracking or delivery claim is displayed.
campaigns.creativeTerritory: The Promise Moves With the Parcel
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for September 2026 planning conversations; client, venue and operating calendar TBC.

campaigns.titleMm: နောက်ဆုံးမိုင်ကို ရှင်းလင်းစေမယ့် Last Mile Ledger
campaigns.format: SME route-visibility retail and merchant activation
campaigns.commercialTension: Small merchants need a practical conversation about deliveries, returns and customer communication without being sold an unverified service promise.
campaigns.audience: SME owners and e-commerce operators who need to frame delivery experience requirements.
campaigns.objective: Move from informal delivery frustration to a client-approved merchant consultation.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A paper 'last-mile ledger' lets merchants prioritise notification, handover or returns questions and book a consented consultation.
campaigns.creativeTerritory: Every Stop Leaves a Clearer Story
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for an early October 2026 SME planning window, with public-holiday operating suitability TBC.

campaigns.titleMm: အေးစက်လမ်းကြောင်းကို မေးမြန်းစေမယ့် Cool Chain Question
campaigns.commercialTension: Perishable-goods teams may know their risk points but lack a neutral process for asking the right handling and handover questions.
campaigns.audience: Food, healthcare and specialty-product teams whose products may require controlled handling; client category TBC.
campaigns.objective: Move from vague concern to a client-approved operational-readiness workshop request.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A mock, non-product tabletop scenario asks participants to identify ownership at each fictional handover and opt into a workshop brief.
campaigns.creativeTerritory: Care Is a Chain of Decisions
campaigns.seasonalLogic: No seasonal assertion; use only after client confirms a relevant category and safety framework.

campaigns.titleMm: အလျင်မတက်ခင် လမ်းကြောင်းစဉ်းစားမယ့် Route Before Rush
campaigns.commercialTension: Business leaders can defer capacity and coordination decisions until a peak period makes the conversation harder.
campaigns.audience: Commercial, operations and procurement leaders responsible for a client-defined seasonal or promotional period.
campaigns.objective: Move from reactive planning to a named, client-approved route and coordination session.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A facilitated 'decision window' board captures non-sensitive planning questions and offers an executive follow-up session.
campaigns.creativeTerritory: Plan the Rush Before It Plans You
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for Q4 2026 planning, with holiday dates used only as calendar guardrails and client demand assumptions TBC.

campaigns.titleMm: ပြန်လာတဲ့ပစ္စည်းကို အကြောင်းပြချက်နဲ့ စီမံမယ့် Return With Reason
campaigns.commercialTension: Returns can create friction between customers, merchants and operations when reason codes, handovers and next actions are unclear.
campaigns.audience: Retail, e-commerce and customer-experience teams exploring a client-defined return journey.
campaigns.objective: Move from uncontrolled return anecdotes to an approved return-journey discovery sprint.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A fictional return card sort turns participant priorities into a consented discovery-sprint request, not a policy or service claim.
campaigns.creativeTerritory: A Return Can Start a Better System
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for November 2026 post-promotion planning; product, merchant and policy context TBC.

campaigns.titleMm: ဆိပ်ကမ်းကနေ ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ဆီသို့ Dock to Decision
campaigns.format: import-export buyer briefing and trade-preview salon
campaigns.commercialTension: Trade stakeholders can discuss containers, documents and timing without a shared framework for what is known, assumed and still requires verification.
campaigns.audience: Import-export, procurement and freight-management decision makers; client segment TBC.
campaigns.objective: Move from broad trade curiosity to a client-approved discovery briefing.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A 'known / confirm / decide' desk turns generic questions into an opt-in appointment for a client-validated briefing.
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for September–December 2026 trade-planning discussions; any port, terminal or carrier reference requires written permission.

campaigns.titleMm: ခရီးလမ်းထဲက အချက်ပြ Signal in Transit
campaigns.commercialTension: Teams may collect operational updates from many people but lack a shared language for which signal triggers which action.
campaigns.audience: Operations teams considering a client-defined visibility or coordination process.
campaigns.objective: Move from tool curiosity to a consented operations-discovery session.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A simulated signal wall asks visitors to route fictional exceptions to an action owner, then book a discovery session.
campaigns.creativeTerritory: See the Signal. Choose the Next Step.
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for October–November 2026 regional operating visits; route, equipment, data and permissions TBC.

campaigns.titleMm: ရပ်နားတိုင်း အရေးကြီးတဲ့ Every Stop Counts
campaigns.format: driver and dispatch appreciation learning programme
campaigns.commercialTension: The people coordinating and completing handovers can be overlooked in brand and process conversations.
campaigns.audience: Client-defined driver, dispatch and customer-service teams; no employment or safety claim implied.
campaigns.objective: Move from one-way recognition messaging to a documented, client-approved listening and learning session.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A facilitated 'one change at my stop' card produces anonymous/consented themes for a client review, not an employment promise.
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for December 2026 reflection and learning; workforce participation, representation and safeguards TBC.

campaigns.titleMm: မိနစ် ၃၀ ဂိုဒေါင် စမ်းသပ်မှု
campaigns.format: warehouse-process open house and controlled challenge
campaigns.commercialTension: Visitors can see a warehouse but may not understand which questions reveal process, safety and handover discipline.
campaigns.audience: Operations and procurement visitors invited to a client-approved, controlled facility or mock-up.
campaigns.objective: Move from passive site interest to a governed process-review appointment.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A non-operational mock picking-and-handover challenge ends with a visitor question card and opted-in follow-up request.
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for November–December 2026; live warehouse access, safety, process, insurance and visitor permissions TBC.

campaigns.titleMm: အနှောင့်အယှက်ကို စီမံမယ့် Resilience Desk
campaigns.format: account-based disruption decision sprint and CRM reactivation
campaigns.commercialTension: Past customer conversations can stall when leaders face disruption, changing priorities or unclear next decisions.
campaigns.audience: Client-owned, consented B2B contacts only; no outreach occurs until the client confirms data rights and messaging.
campaigns.objective: Move from dormant conversation to an explicit re-scope, defer or discovery-decision meeting.
campaigns.conversionMechanism: A three-option decision message routes consented contacts to a client-approved decision sprint; no service-continuity promise is made.
campaigns.creativeTerritory: When the Route Changes, the Conversation Can Continue
campaigns.seasonalLogic: Proposed for December 2026 account-planning, avoiding public-holiday communication dates unless the client confirms suitability.
